title: Line Counter workspace settings (.linecounter/settings.json)
description: Overrides the linecounter.* VS Code settings for this workspace. Keys may be written with or without the 'linecounter.' prefix.

enumDescriptions: Open the statistics page maximized (side bars and panel hidden).
Maximized and additionally switch the VS Code window to full screen.
Open the statistics page like a normal editor tab.
statisticsLayout.description: How the statistics page is opened.

maxFileSizeKB.description: Files larger than this (in KB) are counted by size only; their lines are not analyzed.

linecounter.maxFileSizeKB.description: Files larger than this (in KB) are counted by size only; their lines are not analyzed.

rant.commitWords.markdownDescription: Words or phrases in commit messages to rant about. Leave empty for the built-in list (`wip`, `asdf`, `tmp`, `stuff`, `misc`, `oops`, `typo`, `final`, `please`, `hack`, `whatever`, `idk`, `wtf`, `lol`, `yolo`, `again`, `why`, `test`, `changes`, `update`, `minor`, …).

excludePatterns.markdownDescription: Additional glob patterns to exclude, like `.gitignore` (e.g. `*.generated.ts`, `docs/`, `/build`, `src/**/*.spec.ts`). Shown as the predefined filter *Custom patterns*.

dependencies.enabled.description: Scan package.json / requirements.txt / pyproject.toml / Pipfile / setup.py for the dependency, license and vulnerability report.

linecounter.dependencies.enabled.description: Scan package.json / requirements.txt / pyproject.toml / Pipfile / setup.py for the dependency, license and vulnerability report.

licenses.problematic.markdownDescription: Licenses that are flagged as **problematic** (SPDX ids, `*` wildcards). Example: `GPL*` matches GPL-2.0 and GPL-3.0, but not LGPL.

linecounter.licenses.problematic.markdownDescription: Licenses that are flagged as **problematic** (SPDX ids, `*` wildcards). Example: `GPL*` matches GPL-2.0 and GPL-3.0, but not LGPL.

licenses.review.markdownDescription: Licenses that **need a review** (weak copyleft, unknown or custom licenses).

linecounter.licenses.review.markdownDescription: Licenses that **need a review** (weak copyleft, unknown or custom licenses).

licenses.allowed.markdownDescription: Optional allowlist. If set, every license that does not match is flagged as problematic (e.g. `["MIT", "BSD*", "Apache-2.0", "ISC"]`).

linecounter.licenses.allowed.markdownDescription: Optional allowlist. If set, every license that does not match is flagged as problematic (e.g. `["MIT", "BSD*", "Apache-2.0", "ISC"]`).

licenses.ignorePackages.description: Packages that are accepted exceptions: they stay in the report but are not flagged or checked for vulnerabilities.

linecounter.licenses.ignorePackages.description: Packages that are accepted exceptions: they stay in the report but are not flagged or checked for vulnerabilities.

licenses.includeTransitive.description: Include installed transitive packages (from package-lock.json / node_modules / the virtual environment) in the license report.

linecounter.licenses.includeTransitive.description: Include installed transitive packages (from package-lock.json / node_modules / the virtual environment) in the license report.

vulnerabilities.enabled.markdownDescription: Check npm and PyPI packages for known vulnerabilities via [OSV.dev](https://osv.dev). Only package names and versions are sent.

linecounter.vulnerabilities.includeTrans.description: Also check transitive (installed but not declared) packages for vulnerabilities.

licenses.fetchFromRegistry.markdownDescription: Look up the license of packages that are declared but not installed in the public registries (registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org). Only package names are sent.
